title: So happy The Fantasticks has finally found its way to Broadway! 🌒 The...
transcript: Do you know that feeling when you leave a theatre and you just can't stop smiling because you feel so giddy? That's exactly how I felt walking out of the fantastic. It's intimate, imaginative, and filled with gorgeous music, and was genuinely one of the most delightful nights I've had on Broadway in a very long time. I have loved the fantastic since high school. And now, years later, it's finally on Broadway with a beautiful, queer reimagining that made me fall in love with the show all over again. If you don't know the musical, it's about two. Two young, romantic neighbours who fall in love by moonlight, only to discover that love looks a lot different in the harsh light of day. This is such a joyful, heartfelt and whimsical production with a truly remarkable cast and an incredible example of how to make a classic musical feel brand new.
